notes.title: Development Branch Update 0.2.6
notes.notes:
Fixes

Fixed FPS camera to work as expected and users should no longer see teeth when they're 
in first person mode. 
Fixed issues with storage units not syncing to the correct storage


Changes

Changed how monsters spawn from spawning on top of the user around them to spawning
to any spawning node around a user within 1/2 km this will help users not be overwhelmed when 
playing,

notes.title: Mining and Points of Interest Update
notes.notes:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_h6Wdav55lE
Things Added.

Basic Mining of ores
Points of interest such as the landed vanguard vessel
Map improvements such as center volcano
More spawn points around the map
Basic Ai spawning near the vanguard ship
Prompt that users can't create a game without first submitting a name
Pickaxe added
swimming visuals improved when under water



Various bug fixes
Player Null References on join fixed
Joining games now fixed

notes.title: First Major Update
notes.notes: Our first major update will hit this Friday. We're excited to bring new updates and features to this game and to our fans. Major updates will be pushed every 1st of the month with bug fixes / patches following each release so feedback is more than welcomed. We look forward to continued support for this game and all our titles to come. Thanks for support!

notes.title: Patch Note May 12th
notes.notes:
Fixes

 4k Resolution Support and UI Scaling
 Water now stops vehicles from moving
 Tree colliders fixed
 Inventory Pickup Prompt to notify inventory pickup
 UI Fixes for Main menu
 Added Pickaxe as default melee tool
 Removed reflective probes that caused graphical glitches
Removed Turret from ground vehicle as wasn't working properly



Known Issues to be addressed 

Vehicle Camera now Fixed instead of orbit but has jerky motion
Vehicle Camera isn't rendering water correctly
Engine sounds even though Vehicle has been disabled by water
NPC not spawning Correctly in game

notes.title: Release to Early Access!
notes.notes:
We made it on time as the team worked hard to deliver this product to the steam store. We're excited to be working with the gaming community to make this the best game we can possibly create. This is the First step in a long journey and we'll need everyone's feedback , ideas, and support throughout the journey. Thank you for checking us out. We look forward to the future and stay tuned for more updates to come to the game as we're pushing monthly updates. 

Join our DIscord as well to reach out to us directly. Discord Channel
